{{Top|leg}}
The '''Heart Tree''', also known as the '''World Tree Ch'hala'''<ref name="A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance}}</ref> was a large [[ch'hala tree]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]<ref name="A Plague of Darkness">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: A Plague of Darkness}}</ref> over the hiding place of the [[Eye of the Sun]], a powerful [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] artifact that was concealed on Cularin shortly after the end of the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="The Eye">{{LivingForce|EndTimes: The Eye}}</ref> The Heart Tree was central to Cularin's interconnected network of ch'hala [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and it was considered by the [[Tarasin]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to be sacred.<ref name="A Plague of Darkness" />

During the latter stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Wyrd]]&mdash;a group of Tarasin [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]]&mdash;attacked the Heart Tree and attempted to turn in to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. However, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] himself to save the ch'hala and his Force essence became part of the Heart Tree.<ref name="A Plague of Darkness" /> Shortly after the end of the Clone Wars, the Force-using criminal [[Len Markus]] traveled to the Heart Tree with the [[Darkstaff]], hoping to find the Eye of the Sun. He was attacked near to the tree by the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents, and he used the Darkstaff to summon a group of [[Kilassin]] to fight the agents. However, the Heart Tree summoned a larger Kilassin, which engaged the lesser Kilassin in combat.<ref name="The Eye" />

{{RPG|[[EndTimes: The Eye|''The Eye'']]}}
The Heroes of Cularin eventually defeated Len Markus and destroyed the Darkstaff. The Tarasin sensed through the Force that a threat to the Heart Tree had been averted, so they gathered around the Heart Tree and held a celebration to commemorate the agents' efforts.<ref name="The Eye" />
{{Endgame}}
